definitions.gloss: groper; molester; sexual offender on public transport
definitions.explanation: A person who commits groping or other forms of sexual harassment, especially on crowded trains or in public places. Also refers to the act itself. A persistent social problem in Japan that has led to women-only train cars and anti-groping campaigns.

examples.japanese: {電車|でんしゃ}で{痴漢|ちかん}に{遭|あ}った。
examples.english: I was groped on the train.

examples.japanese: {痴漢|ちかん}は{犯罪|はんざい}です。
{満員|まんいん}{電車|でんしゃ}での{痴漢|ちかん}{被害|ひがい}を{防|ふせ}ぐため、{女性専用車両|じょせいせんようしゃりょう}が{導入|どうにゅう}された。
examples.english: Women-only train cars were introduced to prevent groping on crowded trains.

notes:
USAGE:
Refers both to the person who gropes and to the act of groping. {痴漢|ちかん}に{遭|あ}う means "to be groped" (to encounter a groper). {痴漢|ちかん}をする means "to grope someone."

CULTURAL NOTE:
Groping on crowded trains is a recognized social problem in Japan. Many railway companies have introduced {女性専用車両|じょせいせんようしゃりょう} (women-only cars) during rush hours. Posters warning against {痴漢|ちかん} are common in stations. False accusations are also a concern, leading some men to keep their hands visible on trains.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {痴漢|ちかん}に{遭|あ}う: to be groped
- {痴漢|ちかん}{行為|こうい}: act of groping
- {痴漢|ちかん}{被害|ひがい}: groping victimization
- {痴漢|ちかん}{冤罪|えんざい}: false accusation of groping
- {痴漢|ちかん}{防止|ぼうし}: groping prevention
